{#- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    /llms.txt - a curated, machine-readable map of this site.

    Rendered because "llms.txt" is listed in `feed_filenames` in config.toml,
    which makes Zola write templates/llms.txt to the site root. Zola does not
    autoescape non-HTML templates, so values pass through as written.

    Everything is derived from front matter, so this file cannot go stale.
    Pages under 150 words are skipped so unfinished stubs stay out.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -#}
{#- Parallel arrays, not an array of pairs: Tera 1 cannot parse a nested
    array literal in `set_global`. -#}
